text: {"summary": "The IPO carries an elevated risk rating with a 27.7% probability of an adverse outcome. Key concerns include a high issue price‑to‑earnings ratio of 38.4, about 3.9 times the peer median of 9.8. Profit after tax rose to ₹4.32 crore in FY22, roughly 2.1 times the ₹2.09 crore average of FY20‑21. The lead manager, First Overseas Capital Limited, is named in a SEBI order (sebi‑45441, 24‑Dec‑2019) issued before the bid date. The statutory auditor, Yogesh J Walavalkar And Co., has no prior SME IPOs with a known outcome and changed within three years of the RHP. Several checks passed, including cash‑flow and eligibility criteria, while eight items remain unchecked."}
